semantic_review: Stage boundaries require semantic as well as structural agreement: units, LOT, source and input view.
Repeated identical content, changed source content and interrupted execution have distinct handling; general automatic update/resume is not claimed as implemented.
Input shortage is not normal detection; last failure and earliest divergent stage remain distinguishable.
Rules, outlier scores and forecast deviations have different input units and output meanings; averaging scores is not assumed valid.
Optional, failed and insufficient stages carry their states into subsequent service behavior; retries are bounded by cause and side effects.
scope: E application passages and six adjacent sequences, source preservation and both current editions. Not whole-course meaning, duration, or pipeline runtime validation.
